morphology.pattern_note: 不是马来语派生词，不拆为 sin- 与 clair。所列 IPA 为英语姓名参考读音，不代表所有持名者的实际读法。

senses.zh_definition: 辛克莱：源自诺曼法语地名 Saint-Clair 的姓氏，也可用作名字；具体所指的人或机构须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Sinclair, a surname derived from the Norman French place name Saint-Clair, also used as a given name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada nama tempat Saint-Clair di Normandy dan turut digunakan sebagai nama individu.
senses.nuances: 专名，属于 kata nama khas。输入不能确定具体人物、品牌或机构，因此不能指定某位名人，也不能认定为官方马来语普通词条。以下为姓名使用框架，并非固定搭配。[Behind the Name：Sinclair](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/sinclair)

etymology.historical_story: Sinclair developed from Saint-Clair, a Norman French place name, and became established as a surname in Britain, particularly Scotland. Its history belongs to the movement of names between languages and places, rather than Malay affixation. When it occurs in a Malay text, it normally retains its function as a proper name. [Behind the Name：姓名来源](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/sinclair)
